selection.default_behavior: Block preparation until an explicit choice to use the available LiteRT artifact. These files must not be represented as verified QAT or verified QAT Mobile.

artifacts.revision_source: HF repository metadata saved as gemma4_12b_hf_repo.json and repository tree latest commit

retrieval_limits: LFS pointer pages and current tree revisions were retrieved separately. Immutable-revision HF URLs were unavailable through the research tool. The app requests the pinned revision and validates its exact byte count and SHA-256 before loading, failing if these independently retrieved facts disagree.

qat_evidence.finding: QAT Mobile reference checkpoints use a distinct mobile quantization scheme. Overview links to the QAT collections and identifies LiteRT-LM for mobile use; it does not map the selected .litertlm hashes to those QAT checkpoints.
Official QAT announcement links broadly to the LiteRT Gemma family collection.
Open clarification request asks for the exact QAT-to-LiteRT package path; no maintainer confirmation of these artifacts was found.
Maintainer reports QAT checkpoint conversion unsupported and an early-error change; an unverified alternate exporter is not an app download path.

download_behavior.revision_directory: Materialized downloadBase isolated by repository and immutable revision because HubApi.localRepoLocation omits revision.
download_behavior.authentication: HubApi explicit token takes precedence; nil uses its environment token provider. No token is stored by this app. Catalog pages are public; upstream 401/403 errors are exposed.
download_behavior.integrity: Streaming SHA-256 and exact size before first use; a bounded atomic receipt allows offline reuse for the unchanged local inode, size and mtime. Local app directory is trusted.
download_behavior.progress: LFS reports intermediate byte progress. Automatic Xet path at this dependency pin reports completion only, so incomplete progress stays indeterminate.
download_behavior.resume: Hub cache is preserved after cancellation/network failure. LFS cache path recognizes existing incomplete blobs and Range requests; automatic transport does not guarantee byte-for-byte resume after every cancellation. App does not implement a second downloader.
download_behavior.cancellation: Task cancellation forwarded to the structured library call, explicitly checked after snapshot and during hashing. A late completion cannot publish a cancelled preparation as ready.

memory_policy.macos_query: host_statistics64(HOST_VM_INFO64): free_count + inactive_count, multiplied by host page size. No speculative/purgeable double counting and no allocation probe.
memory_policy.available_reserve: 1 GiB for speech and remaining headroom
memory_policy.note: Conservative application policy estimates, not measured peak memory guarantees. Available memory is sampled again after a download.

validation.unit_tests_run: Seven pure ModelPolicy tests passed; model-file verification and model-store native tests not run.
validation.notes: Actual production ModelCatalog/ModelPolicy compiled in Swift 6 with complete concurrency checking and warning errors. Native file/receipt integrity, download, memory query and engine allocation still require macOS.
